केव् (केवते) To serve, attend to,
wait upon.
केवटः Ved. A hollow, cave.
केवर्तः Ved. A fisherman.

.
--2 Alone, more, sole, only,
isolated; स हितस्य न केवलां श्रियं
प्रतिपेदे सकलान् गुणानपि

.
--3
Whole, entire, absolute, perfect.
--4
Bare, uncovered (as ground);

.
--5 Pure, simple, unmingled,
unattended (by anything else);
कातर्यं केवला नीतिः

.
--6
Selfish, envious.
--ली, --लं The doctrine
of absolute unity of spirit and matter.
--ली Astronomical science.
--लं ind.
Only, merely, solely, entirely,
absolutely, wholly; केवलमिदमेव पृच्छामि

; cf. also 3. 19, 20, 31.
--Comp.
--अन्वयिन् see under अन्वय.
--आत्मन् a. one whose essence is
absolute unity;

.
--ज्ञानिन्
m. the first Arhat.
--द्रव्यं black
pepper.
--ज्ञानं highest Knowledge;

.
--नैयायिकः a mere logician (not
proficient in any other branch
of learning); so ˚वैयाकरण.

केवलतस् ind. Simply, solely,
wholly, purely, merely.

केवलिन् a. (नी f.)
1 Alone, only.
--2 Devoted to the doctrine of
absolute unity of the spirit.
